attempted_claim: Let f_n(X)=X^3-(n-1)X^2-(n+2)X-1 have roots λ_0,λ_1,λ_2, let K_n=Q(λ_0), and define G_{n,s}(X,Y)=∏_{i=0}^2(X-λ_i^sλ_{i+1}^{2s}Y) (indices modulo 3). Does there exist an effectively computable absolute constant C such that every integer solution |G_{n,s}(x,y)|=1 with n≥3, s∈Z\{0}, and |y|≥2 satisfies max{log n,|s|,log|x|,log|y|}≤C?
